dct_title_s: Pontus Euxinus : æquor Iasonio pulsatum remige primum
dct_description_sm: ex conitabus Abrahami Ortelii ; Petrus Kaerius cælavit.
Shows topography, vegetation, waterways (including drainage), ports.
Appears in Jansson's Accuratissima Orbis antiqui delineatio, Amsterdam, 1652.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 61.
"239" and "240" on verso, and Dutch text.
